name: mellin
result.type: {E : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℂ E] → (ℝ → E) → ℂ → E
result.value:
:=
  ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • f t
result.informal_description: The Mellin transform of a function $ f : \mathbb{R} \to E $ at a complex number $ s $ is defined as the Bochner integral over $ (0, \infty) $ of $ t^{s - 1} \cdot f(t) $ with respect to the Lebesgue measure, resulting in an element of the Banach space $ E $.

name: HasMellin
result.type: {E : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℂ E] → (ℝ → E) → ℂ → E → Prop
result.value:
:=
  MellinConvergent f s ∧ mellin f s = m
result.informal_description: The predicate $\text{HasMellin}\, f\, s\, m$ holds if the Mellin transform of $f$ at complex parameter $s$ converges (i.e., $\text{MellinConvergent}\, f\, s$ is true) and evaluates to the element $m$ in the Banach space $E$, meaning $\int_0^\infty t^{s-1} \cdot f(t)\, dt = m$ in the Bochner integral sense.

name: Complex
GammaIntegral_eq_mellin
result.value:
:=
  funext fun s => by simp only [mellin, GammaIntegral, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
result.informal_name: Gamma Function Equals Mellin Transform of Exponential Function
result.informal_description: The Gamma function $\Gamma(s)$ is equal to the Mellin transform of the exponential function $e^{-x}$, i.e., $\Gamma(s) = \int_0^\infty t^{s-1} e^{-t} \, dt$.

name: mellin_comp_inv
result.signature: (f : ℝ → E) (s : ℂ) : mellin (fun t => f t⁻¹) s = mellin f (-s)
result.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] (f : ℝ → E) (s : ℂ),
  mellin (fun t => f t⁻¹) s = mellin f (-s)
result.value:
:= by
  simp_rw [← rpow_neg_one, mellin_comp_rpow _ _ _, abs_neg, abs_one, inv_one, one_smul, ofReal_neg, ofReal_one, div_neg,
    div_one]
result.informal_description: The Mellin transform of the function $ f(t^{-1}) $ evaluated at $ s $ is equal to the Mellin transform of $ f $ evaluated at $ -s $, i.e., $ \mathcal{M}\{f(t^{-1})\}(s) = \mathcal{M}\{f\}(-s) $.

name: mellinInv
result.type: {E : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℂ E] → ℝ → (ℂ → E) → ℝ → E
result.value:
:=
  (1 / (2 * π)) •
    ∫ y : ℝ,
      (x : ℂ) ^ (-(σ + y * I)) •
        f
          (σ + y * I)
            -- next few lemmas don't require convergence of the Mellin transform (they are just 0 = 0 otherwise)
result.informal_description: The Mellin inversion formula for a function $ f : \mathbb{C} \to E $, defined as $ \frac{1}{2\pi} \int_{\mathbb{R}} x^{-(\sigma + iy)} \cdot f(\sigma + iy) \, dy $, where $ \sigma \in \mathbb{R} $ and $ x \in \mathbb{R}_{>0} $. This formula reconstructs a function from its Mellin transform by integrating along the vertical line $ \text{Re}(s) = \sigma $ in the complex plane.
